args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026" (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse).
• Linked article: Autonomous carts raised pick rates by 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
